title: Retire @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow: package, settings option, docs and skill mentions
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## What

Retire `@objectstack/knowledge-ragflow` whole, in one PR, by the maintainer's ruling recorded on #36839 (comment 7134290286, option R1). The package's adapter does not match the real RAGFlow API, nothing in this repo consumes it, and the docs and the published skill teach `adapter: 'ragflow'` as production-ready — an agent following them writes a knowledge source that never works and nothing reports it.

This card carries the RAGFlow half of p1 card #36839; PR #36850 lands the rest of #36839 without touching this package (option B of the same ruling). Neither blocks the other; whichever merges second merges main.

## Surface (origin/main, `git grep -i ragflow`)

| Surface | Where | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Package | `packages/plugins/knowledge-ragflow/` (9 files) | delete the directory |
| Release config | `.changeset/config.json` (fixed group entry) | delete the entry |
| Spec | `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts` (`adapter: z.string()`, free string; `ragflow` only in comments), `contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts`, `knowledge-service.ts` comments | comments only — no tombstone, no ADR-0087 conversion |
| Settings | `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.ts`: the `ragflow` option, its 3 fields, its test-connection branch; its test; `settings-default-action-handlers.pin.test.ts`; the locale strings (11 locales) | delete option, fields, branch, strings |
| Docs | `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`, `ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`, `ai/index.mdx`, `plugins/packages.mdx`, `releases/implementation-status.mdx`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, the `service-knowledge` and `embedder-openai` READMEs, `service-knowledge/package.json` description | delete, or rewrite to the memory / custom-adapter path |
| Published skill | `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (the knowledge example), `evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json` (an eval expecting `adapter: 'ragflow'`) | rewrite the example; rewrite or drop the eval |
| Scripts and ledgers | `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`, `check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs`, `partition-test-shards.mjs`, `test-shard-timings.json`, `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (a comment saying the package pulls `service-knowledge` into a ledger closure), `pnpm-lock.yaml` | clear the entries, regenerate; re-check whether that lint step still needs its premise |
| History | package CHANGELOGs, `releases/v17/17-5.mdx`, `docs/audits/**` | keep as is |

## Acceptance

- `git grep -i ragflow -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!content/docs/releases/v17/**' ':!docs/audits/**'` returns only deliberate prose (e.g. a "retired" note), each hit named in the PR body.
- Measured and recorded in the PR body: (a) what the settings page shows for an environment whose stored knowledge adapter is `ragflow` once the option is gone; (b) what a knowledge source declaring an unregistered adapter does at boot or first use. If (b) is silent, say so in the PR and the seat files the enforcement card — it is not fixed here.
- A changeset for `@objectstack/service-settings` (option removed) and any other published package touched. `Metadata-protocol: none`; no major.
- Skills and the eval change land on a `domain:skills`-reviewed path: `skills/**` is governed, so the seat routes that part per the landing rules (split PR if the tier requires).

## After release (human)

`npm deprecate @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow` with a message such as "Retired and no longer maintained; use knowledge-memory or a custom adapter." The seat files that as a `pm:awaiting-maintainer` card once the dropping release ships.

Responsibility: `objectstack platform code — packages/plugins/knowledge-ragflow, an adapter that does not match the RAGFlow API, taught as production by docs and skill | none: no platform path makes it work | any app author or agent that follows the docs; no consumer in this repo today`
